name: Glow lines and big word
what: Two lines of glowing gold text fade up on a black grid, their letters squeezing together as the glow builds, then one huge word pops in underneath with a warm glow flooding in behind it while the whole block sways gently.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f12 (00:00:00:01-00:00:00:12) the two lines fade up and their stretched letters squeeze to normal while the glow builds; f13 (00:00:00:13) the big word pops in under them (one letter wipes down f13-f15, one grows from a dot f15-f20) and a warm glow floods in behind it to f21 (00:00:00:21); then the block sways gently down and up to f44 (00:00:01:14)
